note: Ch7 = wisdom held as beloved kin (vv.1-5) -> the anatomy of a naive heart yielding to the seductress (vv.6-23) -> guarding the heart's inclination (vv.24-27). Characteristic=inner-being seats/faculties/operations incl. the seductress's own inner traits: heart/sense (lev x4), wisdom, insight, discern, naivety, wily(-of-heart), wayward, bold/impudent, love(dodim/ohab)+delight (illicit affection, vv.18), fool (v22 textual crux H0191), know (the fatal not-knowing v23), life/soul (nephesh v23). Qualifier=relational strengtheners: keeping/binding/writing verbs + their objects (words/commandments/teaching/tablet), body/speech parts (eye/fingers/feet/face/hand/lip/mouth/liver), the way/path-direction motif (derek x4, nathib), seduction mechanics (much/seductive-speech/persuades/smooth/compels/lie-in-wait/seek), and the ruin outcomes (slaughter/arrow/snare/pierce/caught/slain/laid-low/go-down/death). Standalone=agents (son(s)/youth/young-man/husband/woman/adulteress/prostitute), places (house/street/corner/market/window/lattice/Sheol/chambers/Egypt), concrete objects (bed/coverings/linen/myrrh/aloes/cinnamon/bag/money/sacrifices/vows/ox/bird), times, quantifiers, particles/connectives.
